data.name: Gaurish
data.gender_notes: Gaurish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gaurish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gaur' which means 'golden, radiant, bright'. This name is often given to a baby boy as a symbol of light, prosperity, and divine blessings. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is also known as Gaurishankar, representing wisdom and power. The name Gaurish carries the meaning “Golden, Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gaurish usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
